items.title: Sun Pharma’s specialty portfolio, Organon deal to drive growth
items.description: Sun Pharmaceutical achieved notable revenue growth in the September quarter, driven by strong performance in India and specialty medicines. The company anticipates medium-term growth from therapies like Ilumya and ongoing innovative projects. Although profitability was affected by acquisition and litigation costs, the domestic market share increased to 8.6% from last year. R&D investments are expected to rise in the second half of FY27 as development accelerates.

items.title: Reliance Industries eyes growth boost from O2C, retail and Jio businesses
items.description: Reliance Industries has reported a significant growth in revenue and profits for the September quarter. The oil-to-chemicals segment has led this growth while retail segment profitability faced pressures from digital commerce investments. Jio Platforms also reported double digit revenue and profit growth, aided by increased average revenue per user and subscriber additions. Rising inflation and a shift in festive demand to the December quarter may impact future retail earnings.

items.title: Pizza Hut, KFC India operator's Q2 loss naarrows sharply on strong same-store sales growth
items.description: Devyani International, the parent company of KFC and Pizza Hut in India, has recorded a significant reduction in losses during its second quarter. For the third straight quarter, same-store sales for KFC increased by 4.4%. With revenues climbing by 10.4% to 15.19 billion rupees and expenses only rising 8.3%, Chairman Ravi Jaipuria emphasized the ongoing challenges posed by inflation and increasing interest rates.
